messages:
Samir Patel: morning folks, quick sync request 1: reconcile vendor timelines for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi before we freeze marketplace SKUs. Main gating criteria we need agreed: image cert (+manifest), perf variance within 10% of baseline, KMS key present, and no blocking errata.
Nathalie V: uploaded a draft timeline matrix here: https://docs.internal/redwood/hw-roadmap-matrix. please annotate known errata rows. asking vendors to confirm firmware dates by EOD Thu. :spiral_calendar:
Igor Petrov (Intel): MI300 ETA is 2026-05-18 for the initial image, microcode patch pending QA (target signoff 05/16). will flag any known silicon errata in the matrix.
Ann (NVIDIA): H200/B200 images should be available for staging on 2026-05-12. B200 compatibility check vs our old runtime passed basic smoke. will attach NVidia release-notes. nvtx tagging will be included.
Maya Singh (SI): SI request 1: we need golden prompts + eval harness by 2026-05-10 to validate output quality on quantized builds. also need the CI container (perf runner) and sample models. can you confirm delivery?
Samir Patel: yes Maya, well provide eval harness and prompts. also want to standardize SKU naming: rwd-<vendor>-<model>-<quant>. added naming doc link: https://docs.internal/redwood/sku-naming. please use it when claiming staging slots.
Dmitri (MarketplaceBot): heads-up 1: staging SKUs reserved windows available: rwd-nvidia-h200-8q (2026-05-14 to 2026-05-20), rwd-amd-mi300-4q (2026-05-16 to 2026-05-22). Claim via https://marketplace.example/claim.
Samir Patel: embargo policy note: internal partner embargo until cross-cloud smoke passes. public embargo only after canary completes and legal signs off. comms will need templates for vendor/partner outreach.
Nathalie V: propose staggering press/announce slots per vendor by 48 hours to avoid overlap. legal: flagging EU data processing notice window for some partners 1 (cc @LegalOps).
LegalOps: noted on EU notice windows; will provide standard language by 2026-05-07.
Maya Singh (SI): SI integration checklist (short): drivers, runtime versions, hw env vars, node labels, and perf hooks. sample k8s manifest for perf smoke below: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: perf-smoke
spec:
  containers:
  - name: runner
    image: rwd/si/perf-runner:20260508
    resources:
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```
Samir Patel: routing fallback mapping proposed: priority = ["mi300","h200","h100","gaudi"], annotate any fallback as "compat-fallback" in release notes. example config snippet: `routing: {priority: ["mi300","h200","h100","gaudi"]}`. if a vendor slips, we prefer route to a compatible variant rather than hold the marketplace release.
Igor Petrov (Intel): FYI thermal curve change on MI300 microcode was measured: sustained long-seq perf delta ~3-4%. we'll include perf delta in the manifest so customers are aware.
Ann (NVIDIA): we'll publish telemetry schema and nvtx tags. contact list for urgent eskals: ann.nvidia@vendor.example; vendor-ops-phone +1-800-555-0199.
Samir Patel: action items: (1) Vendors confirm firmware/image dates in the matrix (owner: vendors) by 2026-05-07, (2) SI to deliver eval harness + container by 2026-05-10 (owner: Maya), (3) Marketplace teams claim staging slots by 2026-05-09 (owner: Dmitri), (4) Legal provides EU notice text by 2026-05-07 (owner: LegalOps). react with :white_check_mark: when you own an item.
Nathalie V: Ill own press slot staggering and will coordinate with comms. :white_check_mark:
Maya Singh (SI): will deliver harness + runner image by 05/10. :white_check_mark:
Dmitri (MarketplaceBot): staging claim reminders scheduled for 2026-05-08T09:00Z.
Samir Patel: final note 1: add a short rollback play to the runbook: if canary fails, block public embargo and roll traffic back to previous model version, notify partners within 30 minutes, and open incident tag HW-ROADMAP-ROLLBACK. Ill follow up with a 20-min sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm owners. thanks all. :rocket:
